The '''Drift Hills Prison Camp''' was set up by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Galactic War]] the camp was taken over by [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] mercenaries, who imprisoned the Republic personnel along with their former prisoners.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Drift Hills Prison Camp appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
